Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. India Women players stride out to the middle. Followed by Suzie Bates and Sophie Devine who walk out to open for New Zealand Women. Pooja Vastrakar to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then. New Zealand Women need 271 runs to extend their lead in the series. Their batters do have the strength to chase down the target, but it won't be an easy task. Do join us in a short while for the second essay.

Sophie Devine is up for a chat. She says that they scored 275 in the last game so they are positive. Adds that India put away on the bad balls and even the pitch is skiddy and they also put a few chances down as well. Tells, their standards are high but it was just a bad day. Mentions, it doesn't matter who is the captain as all are the leaders.

New Zealand could not capitalize on their advantage. Their bowlers were taken to the cleaners initially. They leaked 100 runs within 20 overs itself. The pressure was building on the bowlers. Later, they kept things simple and started hurting the oppositions batting line-up. It looked like New Zealand Women were under control until a stand between Mithali Raj and Richa Ghosh came to spoil their dreams.

India Women were off to a flying start, thanks to their opening pair of Shafali Verma and Sabbhineni Meghana. The former slipped out but the latter went on to build a good second wicket stand with Yashika Bhatia. India were cruising at 110/1 but soon lost wickets at regular intervals which put them in a teetering position. Later, it was the effort of Raj and Ghosh who made sure to give their bowlers something to fight for. India Women now need to work hard with the ball to equal the series.

India looked out of the game at one point, but Mithali Raj and Richa Ghosh staged a solid fight to put some respect into the total. New Zealand lost their plot with the ball and eventually ended up leaking away more runs than expected. This is the highest ever score for India Women against the White Ferns in an ODI game.
No, they can't! A length ball, on off. Deepti Sharma wrists it to deep mid-wicket and will collect only a single. India Women end at 270/6.
A single as Mithali Raj drags this outside off delivery to deep mid-wicket for a single. Can India Women finish on a high?
Deepti Sharma comes in to bat now.
OUT! TAKEN! A full ball, straight on middle. Pooja Vastrakar looks to slog it but gets a top edge, in the air and towards deep mid-wicket where Amelia Kerr takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Amelia Kerr b Jess Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, outside off. Raj comes down and hits it to deep cover for a single.
A slower full ball, outside off. Raj shuffles and paddles it to the fine leg region for a brace.
Full and on middle. Pooja Vastrakar pushes it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A full ball, on off. Pooja skips down and mistimes here hit to deep covers for a single.
Fullish delivery, on off. Raj sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, pushed to covers for another quick single.
A full ball, down the leg side. Raj sweeps it fine, the keeper got a hand to it and stopped it from running away. A single. She has hurt herself in the process.
Length and on off, slapped to mid off for a quick single.
Length ball, outside off. Mithali Raj goes inside out over covers for a single.
Outside off, on a length. Pooja Vastrakar swings and misses.
A short ball, on middle. Mithali ramps it over the keeper's head for three runs as it is cut off in the deep.
Length ball, on off. Raj thumps it to deep mid-wicket and the fielder runs to his left, slides and saves a couple.
Length and on off, pushed to mid off for a quick single.
FOUR! Edged! A full ball, on off. Pooja Vastrakar looks to swing across the line but gets an outside edge to the third man fence.
A full toss and this is pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Length and on  off. Pooja taps it to point.
Length again and this time Mithali Raj heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, on off, nudged to mid-wicket.
Very full and on middle. Pooja Vastrakar squeezes it out to mid on for a single.
Length ball, slower and outside off, dragged to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on off. Pooja Vastrakar drops it to covers for a run.
Full and on middle, pushed to mid on.
Pooja Vastrakar comes in at number 7.

OUT! TAKEN! New Zealand finally have a breakthrough and at a crucial time as well. This is short and on middle. Richa Ghosh skips down, pulls it, she gets more elevation than distance and Amelia Kerr at deep mid-wicket takes a good catch. End of a fighting innings from  Richa Ghosh.
Commentary.Howout: c Amelia Kerr b Sophie Devine

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball now, outside off. Richa swings and misses. Mithali Raj has a word immediately.
A low full toss, angling down. Richa makes room and looks to heave but misses it.
Length and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Yet another fifty for Mithali Raj! A full ball, outside off. Raj lifts it over point for a boundary.
On off, defended to covers.
Full and outside off. Ghosh comes down the track and lofts it towards long off. The fielder in the deep does well to keep it down to two.
Full and outside off. Raj pushes it to cover for a quick single.
Full and on leg, Ghosh clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Raj pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Short and on leg. Ghosh helps it to mid-wicket for one.
Floated, full and on off. Ghosh gets low and lofts it over the bowler's head. It lands safely and they take one.
Full and on off. Ghosh shuffles across and looks to scoop it away but does not connect well.
A sharp bouncer, on leg. Ghosh make room and looks to chase it but misses.
FOUR! Nicely played. A full toss, on off. Ghosh stands back and smokes it over mid off for a boundary.
Devine fires in a yorker, in the blockhole. Ghosh jams it out solidly.
Full and wide outside off. Raj carves it to sweeper cover for one.
A single to end the over as this is worked towards mid off.
WIDE! Flatter and down leg. Raj leaves it alone. Wide called.
Tossed up, full and on leg. Ghosh gets low and slog-sweeps it to deep square leg. The ball meets the fielder on a bounce. Single taken.
FOUR! Richa Ghosh is on a roll now! Flighted, full and outside off. Ghosh slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Full and on leg. Raj gets low and sweeps it to fine leg. The batters run three comfortably.
Flatter and on off. Ghosh pushes it out for a single.
Flighted, full and on middle. Raj makes room and lofts it towards long off for one.
Looped up, full and on leg. Raj sweeps it to deep square leg for just a single.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Raj chips it to mid off but with soft hands.
FIFTY FOR GHOSH! Her maiden half-ton in ODI. This is full and on off. Ghosh pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
This is very full and straight on the off stump. Ghosh jams it out to point.
Fuller and on off. Raj drives it into cover for one.
Not much power on the shot! Fuller, on middle and leg. Raj lofts it towards deep mid-wicket. They take two before the fielder cuts it out.
6 runs off the over then! Slower through the air, full and on off. Raj chips it aerially towards cover for one.
On off, pushed to cover for one.
WIDE! Flatter, sliding down leg. Ghosh looks to chase it but misses. Wide called.
Full toss, on middle. Raj hits it to mid off for a quick single.
A single as this is worked to mid off.
Flatter and on the stumps. Ghosh defends it out solidly.
Full and angled into the pads. Raj makes room and pushes it to mid off for one.
Powerplay 2 comes to an end. Now, maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of 50th over.
A single as this is hit to point.
A full ball, on middle. Richa smashes it to long on for a single.
SIX! Makes full use of it. Pitches it up, on off. Ghosh gets under it and smacks it over long on for a biggie.
NO BALL! Mair goes wide of the crease and serves it down the leg side. Ghosh leaves it alone, No ball given as Mair crossed the return crease. Free hit coming up.
A yorker, on leg. Ghosh backs away and defends it out.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for one more.
Full and on middle, drilled down to long on for a run.
Angles it on middle, defended to covers.
Length and on off. Raj guides it to point.
FOUR! Finds the gap! A length ball, on middle. Raj pulls off the back foot and bisects square leg and mid-wicket in the deep for a boundary.
A full ball, on off, pushed to covers for a single. Richa Ghosh is struggling.
A single as Mithali Raj pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball drifting on middle. Richa pulls it hard to deep square leg for a single.
Richa Ghosh is down again. She looks to be in some pain as the physio treats her injured leg. The magic spray comes out and Ghosh is fine to continue says the physio.
Flatter and outside off. Raj slaps it to point where the fielder makes a good stop.
A single as this is hit to mid-wicket.
Again tries the same shot but fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! Richa Ghosh is struggling to run so she takes the other route! Length and outside off. Ghosh slashes it and beats the diving fielder in the deep for a boundary.
A loopy ball, outside off, driven to covers for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Ghosh sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
This time Richa Ghosh pulls it to the square on the leg side for a single.
On middle, pushed to mid on.
Short ball, on middle. Mithali rides the pull shot to deep backward square leg for a single.
Length and on off, tucked to mid-wicket.
A length ball, outside off. Mithali looks to poke at it bubt misses.
Length ball, outside off, pushed to deep covers for a single.
Short and outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Flatter again. Mithali waits till the last moment to play it past short third man and take another two runs.
Flatter and outside off. Raj dabs it past short third man for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, outside off. Raj steps down and across to block it out.
Full and on off. Ghosh slog-sweeps  it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off. Raj works it to mid off. The pair is picking up the scoring rate now.
Full, on middle. Ghosh sweeps it to mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up, around middle and leg. Ghosh stays back and blocks it out watchfully.
Around leg, Ghosh glances it to fine leg for a couple more runs.
Two more! Fuller, around off. Ghosh gets underneath and lifts it towards long off. The ball meets the fielder on a bounce.
Short and outside off. Ghosh cuts it past point. They take two before the fielder cuts it out.
Floated, full and outside off. Raj drives it to cover but not in the gap.
Richa Ghosh is down due to a slip while taking a run. Might have just twisted her ankle and the physio is tending her.
Full and on leg. Ghosh drags his sweep to long leg. The batters settle with just one as Richa Ghosh fell after taking the run.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Ghosh guides it towards backward point. The fielder fumbles and the batters take two.
FOUR! Perfect sound off the blade. Full, around middle and leg. Ghosh gets low and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Slightly short, on the pads. Ghosh looks to pull it away but misses.
Floated, full and on leg. Raj gets low and sweeps it toward fine leg. The batters take three with ease.
Short ball, outside off. Ghosh makes room and looks to cut it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Ghosh works it towards mid on.
Full and on off. Ghosh blocks it to covers.

DROPPED AND A BOUNDARY! Tosses it up, full and on off. Ghosh lofts it towards long. The fielder in the deep misjudges the boundary and hence she was unable to get a hold of it. The ball runs into the fence.
Short and on off. Ghosh goes back defends it to point.
Floated, full and on off. Ghosh hits it firmly to wide of long off for a brace.
Tossed up, full and on off. Raj defends it to cover off the outer half.
An easy single now, as this is worked towards cover.
Full and on off. Ghosh pushes it to cover with soft hands.
Flatter and on off. Ghosh plays it towards mid off.
Overpitches it, on off. Raj drives it into cover for a quick single.
Full and outside off. Raj defends it out to cover.

Drinks! Repair work going on with Mithali Raj and Richa Ghosh in the middle. The game is properly balanced and both will look to finish the innings on high. It relies heavily on Mithali Raj from here.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for India Women. Floated, full and on off. Ghosh gets low and slogs it over mid on for a boundary.
Fuller, on off. Ghosh chips it to mid off but short of the fielder.
Slower through the air, full and on off. Ghosh blocks it out to covers.
Floated, full and on off. Raj uses her feet and gets it into covers for a single.
Full and on off. Raj comes down the track and drives it to mid off but straight to the fielder.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Raj defends it to point.
Fuller ball, outside off. Mithali drives it through covers for a single.
A single as this is hit through covers.
An appeal for LBW but not given! Full ball, slanting down leg. Richa misses her flick and gets hit on the pads.
A flighted ball, outside off. Ghosh looks to cut but misses. The keeper flicks the bails off but Ghosh never left here crease.
Full and on off, pushed to point.
A full ball, swinging around off. Ghosh looks to defend but it takes the inside edge onto the pads.
A loopy one, on middle, Raj bunts it to mid-wicket.
A huge appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Full ball, slanting on middle and leg. Mithali leans to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. Was angling down.
Flatter and on off, hit to covers.
On middle, driven to long on for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off. Ghosh chips it to mid off.
Richa Ghosh is the batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fran Jonas strikes straight back in her second spell. A full toss, on off. Kaur comes down the track and pulls it in the hands of Amelia Kerr at mid-wicket where she takes it very low. It is taken upstairs to check the height and catch. The soft signal is out. The catch is taken properly. Now onto the delivery and as Kaur came down the track, the on-field decision stays. OUT shows the big screen.
Commentary.Howout: c Amelia Kerr b Fran Jonas

Commentary.Commentary: Is that a clean catch? The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The soft signal is OUT. The replays confirm the catch was a clean one and also confirms that the ball was hit below waist height. The final decision is OUT.
Fran Jonas (4-0-23-0) is back into the attack now.
Fullish delivery, on off, pushed to extra cover.
Length and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
A single as this is hit to mid-wicket.
In the air and falls safe! Fuller, dipping ball, on middle. Mithali looks to sweep but gets a top edge, over the keeper for a single.
On middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Kaur gets across the line of the ball and defends it.
An appeal for LBW but not given! A length ball, nipping in, on middle. Raj misses her flick and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but height might be the issue.
Short ball near the off pole. Raj ducks under it.
Length and on off. Mithali hops and blocks it.
A length ball, outside off. Raj has a feel for it and she misses.
Short one, slower and outside off. Left alone.
Full ball, on off. Kaur pushes it to mid off for a quick single. The fielder scores a direct hit but Harmanpreet made it quick.
On middle, heaved to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, angling on middle. Kaur shuffles and looks to flick but gets a leading edge just in front of the cover fielder.
Full and on off. Mithali works it to point. A fumble there and a single is taken..
Length ball, outside off. Kaur punches it through covers for a single.
Length and outside off. Raj guides it to third man for a single.
Full and on off, pushed to covers.
Jess Kerr is back on.
Fuller, outside off. Kaur presses forward and drives it to mid off for no runs.
On middle and leg. Kaur defends it to mid-wicket.
Full length, on off. Kaur hits it to wide of long off.
WIDE! Fuller, sliding down leg. Kaur looks to chase it but misses. Wide called.
Full ball, around off. Raj works it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Glorious shot! Full length, wide outside off. Raj leans in and carves it through the gap at covers for a boundary.
Fuller, outside off. Raj stays back and defends it to cover.
Fuller, on off. Kaur defends it into the deck.
Short and on leg. Raj clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on off. Raj plays it back to the bowler.
BEATEN! Looped up, outside off. Raj leans in and tries to defend it inside the line but misses.
Outside off, Raj defends it to point.
Tosses it up, outside off, it grips and turns away. Raj is drawn forward but gets beaten on the outside off.
Two dots in a row to end the over. Fuller, on middle and leg. Kaur clips it to mid-wicket.
Full length, on the stumps. Kaur strides and defends it onto the deck.
WIDE! Full and down leg. Kaur looks to flick but misses. Wide called.
Fuller, on leg. Raj flicks it to square leg for another single.
Full length, outside off. Kaur pushes it to cover for one run.
WIDE! Fuller, sliding down leg. Kaur misses her flick. Wide called.
Full, on off, pushed to covers for one. Raj is off the mark now.

Bonus runs! Fuller, outside off. Kaur taps it to cover and takes off for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. The backup is not up to the point and they sneak a couple more due to overthrows.

Quicker, full and on the stumps. This one stays low off the deck. Raj gets her blade down in time and defends it to the leg side. A brilliant over by Amelia Kerr comes to an end. A wicket and just a run off it.
Floated, full and on leg. Raj defends it to mid on.
On the pads, Kaur clips it to mid-wicket for a single. She gets off the mark.
Tosses it up, outside off. Kaur leaves it alone.
Harmanpreet Kaur comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! This is a soft dismissal. Sabbhineni Meghana is not happy with herself, she misses out on her fifty. Floated, full, around middle and leg. Sabbhineni Meghana chips it back to the bowler. Amelia Kerr keeps her eyes on the ball and pouches it comfortably. Another set batter walks back and suddenly New Zealand Women have life in this innings.
Angled into the body, short. Sabbhineni Meghana blocks it out watchfully.
Full length, outside off. Raj leaves it alone for the keeper. She need a sighter before attempting to play outside the line.
Very full and straight at the stumps. Raj gets her blade down in time and blocks it out.
Short ball, on middle. Sabbhineni Meghana pulls it to mid-wicket off the bottom half for one.
Mithali Raj is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! After dropping a few chances. Suzie Bates does not miss this opportunity and completes the catch to break this stand. A short ball, on off. Bhatia swings across the line, it flies off the outside edge towards mid on. Bates takes a dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c Suzie Bates b Sophie Devine

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, down leg. Sabbhineni Meghana works it to short fine leg for a single.
Short ball, outside off. Bhatia taps it to point for a single.
Fuller, outside off, a leg breaker. Meghana skips down to go big on the off side but misses. The keeper fumbles to collect.
On middle. Blocked out.
A direct hit and it would have been curtains for Bhatia! This is full and on off. She taps it to covers and takes off for a quick single. The fielder misses her shy at the bowler's end.
Flatter and on off. Bhatia nudges it to mid-wicket.
Short and outside off. Bhatia cuts it to point.
FOUR! A short ball, too slow in the air and it gives ample time to Bhatia to paddle sweep it to the fine leg fence.
An eventful over from Sophie Devine comes to an end! Length and on off, pushed to covers.
Short of a length, on middle. Bhatia looks to pull but it takes the top edge over square leg for a single.
Full and on off, pushed straight to mid off.
Around off. Bhatia keeps it out.

DROPPED! Sophie Devine is already celebrating before that catch is taken but it has been dropped! Short ball, on middle. Gets too big on Sabbhineni Meghana as she pulls it straight to deep square leg fielder who drops a sitter.
A fuller ball, on off. Sabbhineni Meghana pushes off the inner half back to Devine. A bit of aggression there as she has a shy at the keeper's end.
Another googly, lands it outside off and lets it turn away from the left-hander. Left alone.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single. 100 up for India.
A googly, turning away from the batter, Bhatia reads it well and dabs it past first slip for a couple of runs.
Very full, on middle. Bhatia sweeps it to the fine leg region for a brace.
On middle. Blocked back to Kerr.
A single! Full and on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Slightly short, on the pads, tucked to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket.
Chance! A quicker one from Jonas, on middle. Bhatia chips it to the left of Jonas. She moves across and gets her left hand out but fails to catch it.
Tossed up, fuller and on off. Meghana skips down and lifts it over covers for a single.
A single as this is drilled down to long on.
Flatter ball, quicker and on off, pushed to covers.
On middle. Sabbhineni wrists it to mid-wicket.
Shorter and on off. Meghana pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs.
A flighted ball, on off. Meghana defends it back.
WIDE! Fuller and down the leg side. Meghana misses her flick.
Short again and this time she pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and around off. Bhatia steers it past short third man for a brace.

Drinks! So far so good for India Women. A strong start was needed and they have got one. Now it is time to capitalize on it and play the middle-phase without much damage. New Zealand Women need wickets and better fielding as well. Looked a bit wayward in this opening hour.
Tossed up, full and on off. Sabbhineni Meghana advances down the track and pushes it to cover.
A single as this is worked to long on.
FOUR! Yastika Bhatia will not miss on such freebies. A full toss, on off. Bhatia stands back and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Full on off, blocked out solidly.
Short and outside off. Bhatia looks to chase it but misses.

A risky single! Fuller, on off, Sabbhineni Meghana pushes it to mid off. The batters decide to take a run. The fielder collects the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. If it was a direct hit things could've been different.
Full length, wide outside off. Bhatia reaches out and blocks it towards point.
Fuller, outside off. Bhatia defends it to point.
A short ball, on leg. Bhatia looks to pull it away but misses.
Full, outside off, blocked out.
FOUR! Timed to perfection. Floated, full and outside off. Yastika Bhatia hangs back and drives it uppishly over point for a boundary.
Full length, outside off. Bhatia chops it to covers.
FOUR! Wow, this is a wonderful shot! Very full, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana stays back and lofts it over covers for a boundary. 9 runs off the over.
Short, on top of the stumps. Bhatia stays back and flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Tosses it up, outside off. Bhatia works it out.
Full and outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana pushes it to mid off for a quick single.
FOUR! Up and over! Flighted, full, around middle and leg. Sabbhineni Meghana lofts it over long on for a boundary.
Fuller, on middle. Sabbhineni Meghana comes down and blocks it back to the bowler.
Fuller, wide outside off, Bhatia leans in and pushes it to mid off.
Fuller, on off. Bhatia pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Glorious! Full length, outside off. Bhatia reaches out and drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
A length ball, on off. Bhatia defends it towards mid on.
WIDE! A length ball, angling down leg. Bhatia looks to chase it but misses. Wide called.
Fuller, on off, Bhatia defends it out.
Yastika Bhatia walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rosemary Mair strikes and draws the first blood. A full-length ball, on off. Verma makes room and lobs it towards mid off. She does not get much elevation off his back foot. Later, Amy Satterthwaite back pedals and takes a sharp catch above her head.
Commentary.Howout: c Amy Satterthwaite b Rosemary Mair

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, on middle and leg. Verma works it down the ground for one.
On off, blocked out solidly.
Floated, full and on off. Sabbhineni Meghana lofts it towards covers, but it lands in a vacant area. Single taken.

A tough chance goes begging. Tossed up, full and on off. Shafali Verma hangs back and ends up hitting it high in the air towards mid on. The fielder runs backward but fails to pouch the ball in the end. One taken.
Fuller, on off. Sabbhineni Meghana lofts it over extra cover for one.
Flighted, full and outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana drills it to mid off. The fielder there dives to her right to make a sharp stop.
End of Powerplay 1! That means now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, Fran Jonas is into the attack.
Length and outside off. Meghana dabs it to third man for a single to end the over. India Women with a very good start here.
Short in length, outside off. Shafali cuts it late and to third man for a single.
Length and on off. Blocked out.
Short one and Shafali evades it.

In the air and safe! A length ball, on off. Meghana looks to heave but is a touch early and it goes off the outer half just over the leaping mid off fielder. Three runs taken till the fielder chases it back.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Same delivery as the previous one and Verma opts for safety here as she sits under it.
A pacy short ball, outside off. Verma ducks under it.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Meghana is playing aggressively here! Fullish delivery, outside off. She lifts it over covers for a boundary. 50 up for India.

On a length, on middle. Verma wrists it to mid on.
Length and on off. Defended out.
Touch fuller, on middle. Verma flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Length and on off. Verma hits it to covers.
Leg bye! Fuller and angling on the pads, flicked past the keeper, off the pads and to the fine leg region for a leg bye.

Short again and this time Verma sits under it.
Short in length, on leg. Hooked away to fine leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Verma punches off the back foot through the diving backward point fielder for a single as third man comes across.
Fuller again, outside off. Verma carves it to covers.
Full, outside off and this is tapped away to point.
On middle. Blocked out.
FOUR! 22 off the over! Short of a length, on middle. This time, Meghana pulls it to the mid-wicket fence.
FOUR! Two in a row! Fuller again, outside off. Meghana takes a step forward and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! India Women with a positive start! Fuller and on off. Sabbhineni Meghana steps down and goes inside out through covers for a boundary.

A full ball, angling outside off, pushed to mid off.
Short and outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana looks to chase it but misses.
WIDE! Length ball, moving outside the tramline. Wide called by the umpire.
Short and on off. Sabbhineni Meghana works it to point.
BEATEN! Full length, outside off, shaping away late. Sabbhineni Meghana shuffles across a long way and looks to poke it out but misses.
Good length, outside off, moving away. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to chase it but misses.
Full and outside off, swinging away. Sabbhineni Meghana gets across and looks to defend it inside the line but misses.
EDGY! A length ball, outside off. Shafali Verma is a little early into her shot. It flies off the outside edge through backward point for a single.
FOUR! Yet again a boundary comes off the final ball off the over. Full-length ball, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana slaps it through covers for one.
Length ball, on the stumps, Sabbhineni Meghana blocks it back to the bowler.
Short and on off. Sabbhineni Meghana defends it into the off side.

Just beats the fielder! Full and outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana lofts it towards mid off. The fielder there moves to her right but the ball goes past her. They take two before the fielder cuts it out.
Fuller, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana pushes it to cover.
Jess Kerr continues to get a good amount of swing. Fuller, outside off, inswinger. Sabbhineni Meghana stays back and nudges it to the leg side.
FOUR! This boundary spoils a good over for Hayley Jensen. Fuller, outside off. Verma leans in and drives it through the cover region for a boundary. India Women off to a cautious start.
Full length, outside off. Verma carves it to point but not in the gap. 5 dots in a row!
On a length, on off stump. Verma hangs back and blocks it back to the bowler.
Length ball, on off. Verma blocks it out to safety.
Two dots in a row! Good length, outside off. Verma hangs her blade out and looks to defend it out but misses.
Full length, on off. Verma stays back and defends it out watchfully.
Fuller, outside off. Verma drives it to sweeper cover for a single. Just 1 run off it. Jess Kerr starts with a brilliant spell.
An inswinging, full-length delivery, outside off. Verma defends it back to the bowler.
A length ball, on off. Verma works it to point.
Fuller, inswinger, on off. Verma defends it out solidly.
Back of a length, outside off, nips in a long way. Verma looks to cut it away but only finds an outside edge. It flies to the fielder at first slip, who spills it out in the end.
Full length, on off. Verma defends it towards mid off.
Who will start from the other end? It is Jess Kerr.
Full length, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana drives it through covers for a brace. A tidy start by Hayley Jensen, just 5 runs off it.
OH LUCKY! Fuller, outside off. Verma is enticed yet again. The ball goes to third man off the outside edge. One taken.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off, angled in and shaping away. Shafali Verma tries to fiddle but gets beaten on the outside edge.
LEG BYE! Length ball, on the pads. Meghana fails to clip it. It rolls out off the pads and they take a leg bye.
Full-length ball, outside off, moving away. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to chase it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
WIDE! Full, wide outside off and outside the tramline. Sabbhineni Meghana signals it as a wide.
A length ball, outside off, shaping away a hint. Sabbhineni Meghana thinks about having a go away from her body but keeps her blade close to her body in the end.
We are all set for the action. The players walk out to the middle. Shafali Verma and Sabbhineni Meghana are the openers for India Women! Hayley Jensen to operate with the ball. Here we go ...

Sneh Rana is up for a quick chat. She says all the bowlers are hoping to do well. Adds, the side has quality spinners, and everyone has different attributes that make them stand out which is really crucial for the side. Adds, nothing is hard it is only a matter of time before one gets used to the conditions.

PITCH REPORT - Aimee Watkins is near the deck. She says, there is not much in it for the spinners. Adds there is green grass on the deck. Mentions, it is a really good surface and we should witness some really good game.

New Zealand Women (Playing XI) - Suzie Bates, Sophie Devine, Amelia Kerr, Amy Satterthwaite (C), Maddy Green, Brooke Halliday, Katey Martin (WK), Hayley Jensen, Jess Kerr, Rosemary Mair (In for Lea Tahuhu), Fran Jonas (In for Hannah Rowe).

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Sabbhineni Meghana, Yastika Bhatia, Mithali Raj (C), Harmanpreet Kaur, Richa Ghosh (WK), Deepti Sharma, Pooja Vastrakar, Simran Bahadur (In for Jhulan Goswami), Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Poonam Yadav.
TOSS - India Women have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first!

Suzie Bates was in action as she scored a brilliant century in the first ODI. Amy Satterthwaite scored a half-century as well and helped New Zealand Women post 275. Other than Yastika Bhatia and Mithali Raj, everyone had a decent outing and in the end India Women could not take a lead in this series. More will be expected from the likes of Harmanpreet Kaur who’s middle order failure is hurting team India. Will India Women level the series? Or will the hosts continue their domination? We shall find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the second ODI of this 5-match series between New Zealand Women and India Women. Things are not going as per plan for India Women who went on the tour to test themselves before the mega event but unfortunately the only thing they tasted till now is defeat. While New Zealand Women are enjoying this tour and till now they haven't put a wrong foot forward.
